locked_input_note: This document is part of the locked input set. It records the policy under which every fact-to-evidence relation was reviewed row by row; the relations themselves are declared in work/pilot_facts_v2_*.json and are locked by the same input digest.

roles.SUPPORTS: the evidence states the assertion for this subject and scope; it counts toward establishing the value and, when it carries a date, toward the assertion's time qualification
roles.REFUTES: the evidence contradicts the assertion; it may qualify the date but never establishes the value
roles.CONTEXT_ONLY: the evidence is background for this subject (parent-company material, an unnamed counterparty, a different scope, or a weak lead); it is displayed and never establishes the value or supplies the assertion's event/publication date
roles.REPLACES: the evidence supersedes another source on the same point; the conflict is preserved rather than averaged
roles.ACCESS_NOTE: the row records an access outcome (404, blocked body, search with no hits); it can never establish a value
roles.INHERITED_CONTEXT: inherited local material kept for traceability only

rules_applied: No relation is inferred from an evidence id prefix; the submitted package derived SUPPORTS from the B_ prefix, which the acceptance rejected.
Every evidence row referenced by a fact must carry an explicit relation declaration; the builder fails hard when one is missing.
Only SUPPORTS and REFUTES relations may supply a fact's event date or publication date.
A company's own material never becomes an outside confirmation: evidence with claim_nature COMPANY_SELF_REPORT keeps the fact at COMPANY_SELF_REPORT.
Hiring documents establish hiring scope and requirements; they are never used as proof that the company already performs the activity.
Parent-company material is recorded as CONTEXT_ONLY for the team-level subject and can never fill a team field.

Acceptance findings applied row by row: B_US_AMAZON_FTR_007 (parent context, not a target-market support), B_US_AMAZON_FTR_004 (page binding corrected to job 10426076, and its text used only as hiring scope plus background), B_CN_XSQUARE_008 (service coverage, not payment, repeat order or sustained use), B_CN_XSQUARE_009 (financing and shareholding, not listing status), B_CN_FOURIER_010 (access note, not a channel fact).

counts_before_repair.note: 83 of 83 links were SUPPORTS, which is why background and access-failure material silently supported facts.
